title: Network downloads
description: Download M3U8 on-demand streams or public Douyin videos as local MP4 files.
addressHint: Paste the full URL, or the entire Douyin share message.
toolsMissing: FFmpeg and ffprobe were not found on this computer. Install both and restart Assemble. Server FFmpeg is not used for local downloads.
emptyHint: Paste a URL or import a playlist, then select quality and start downloading.
interrupted: Interrupted on exit. Parse the source again.

error.DOWNLOAD_INVALID_SOURCE: Enter a publicly accessible video download link or paste a Douyin share message.
error.IMPORT_DOWNLOAD_LINK_NEEDED: Could not get the video from this file. Paste the link used to download the M3U8 file and select the file again, or use the browser extension.
error.DOWNLOAD_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source is unavailable or expired. Obtain a new URL.
error.DOWNLOAD_NETWORK: The network connection failed. Try again later.
error.DOWNLOAD_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported source. On-demand playlists, standard AES-128 and public Douyin videos are supported. Live streams and DRM are not supported.
error.DOWNLOAD_LIMIT: Source exceeds a limit: 10 GiB, 20,000 segments, or a 4 MiB playlist.
error.DOWNLOAD_INVALID_MEDIA: The file is incomplete or is not a valid video. It was not published to the downloads folder.
error.DOWNLOAD_STORAGE: Could not save the file. Check folder permissions, free space and hard-link support.
error.DOWNLOAD_TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE: Local FFmpeg or ffprobe was not found. Install both and restart.
error.DOWNLOAD_PROCESSING: Could not merge the video. Its codecs may be incompatible with MP4.
error.DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED: The preview expired. Parse the source again.
error.DOWNLOAD_BUSY: The queue is full or the task is still running. Try again later.
error.unknown: The operation did not complete. Try again.
